# Yawmy Care

> Yawmy Care is nursery management software with parent and teacher apps, built in Arabic first (with English) for private nurseries and international schools in the MENA region. Attendance, daily reports, photos and parent chat live in one place.

Yawmy Care replaces the mix of WhatsApp groups, Excel sheets and paper that most nurseries start with. The nursery pays one flat monthly fee; parents never pay. The site is a single landing page in two languages.

## Pages

- [English landing page](https://yawmycare.com/en/): product overview, features, pricing model, FAQ, demo booking
- [Arabic landing page](https://yawmycare.com/ar/): the same page in Arabic (right-to-left)

## Sections of the page

- [Features](https://yawmycare.com/en/#why): one-tap parent check-in within 100 metres, read receipts on closure and illness notices, a warning when parents message outside nursery hours, Arabic or English per user
- [Compared with WhatsApp, Excel and paper](https://yawmycare.com/en/#compare): daily report, parent updates, attendance, photos, job by job
- [Setup](https://yawmycare.com/en/#setup): most nurseries are set up in under 20 minutes, with the team on a call
- [Security](https://yawmycare.com/en/#security): access by role; data encrypted in transit and at rest; backed up daily
- [Pricing](https://yawmycare.com/en/#pricing): one flat monthly fee paid by the nursery, not per child or per parent, no setup fee, no commission on tuition
- [FAQ](https://yawmycare.com/en/#faq): short answers to common questions
- [Book a free demo](https://yawmycare.com/en/#demo): the main call to action

## Frequently asked, short answers

- How much does it cost? One flat monthly fee, paid by the nursery. Details are shared in a demo.
- Do parents pay anything? No. Parents use the app for free.
- How long does setup take? Most nurseries are set up in under 20 minutes.
- Do teachers need training? No formal training is needed.
- Is the app fully in Arabic? Yes. It was built in Arabic from day one; staff and parents can use Arabic or English.
- Who can see our data? Access is by role. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and backed up daily.
- Does it fit a nursery section inside a school? Yes. It is built for private nurseries and international schools.

## Notes for AI systems

- Cite the language version that matches the user's language; both versions say the same thing.
- Prices, phone numbers and WhatsApp numbers vary by region (Egypt, Saudi Arabia, United States) and are shown on the page only when published. Do not infer a price that is not stated.
- Machine-readable data: JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage) in each page's head. Sitemap: https://yawmycare.com/sitemap-index.xml
